newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia mounts operation to save starving reindeer.
newsitem.headline: Russia mounts operation to save starving reindeer.

text.p: Russia is using tractors and special off-road vehicles to save starving reindeer in the far eastern region of the country bordering Alaska, Itar-Tass news agency reported on Tuesday.

About 3,000 reindeer have already died of starvation and from smashing their feet on ice that has covered their traditional feeding grounds in the Chukotka region, the head of the local civil defense service, Yury Zhulin, told Tass.
The vehicles will uncover meadows by breaking through the ice and will also lead reindeer to other feeding areas by lining the route with mixed fodder, Tass said.
The 240,000 reindeer play a vital role for the largely indigenous residents of the remote Chukotka region. Residents use reindeer for transport, clothing and food.
